name: falegnameria-radice-demo
description: Demo artigiana Qwik City SSR — milestone 1

scripts.build.server: qwik check-client src dist && vite build -c adapters/cloudflare-pages/vite.config.ts
scripts.test: npm run test.unit && npm run test.ssr
scripts.test.unit: tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && node tests/prepare-components.mjs && node --conditions=development --test tests/configurator.test.mjs tests/configurator.component.test.mjs
scripts.fmt: prettier --write src adapters tests vite.config.ts eslint.config.js package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.tests.json wrangler.jsonc
scripts.fmt.check: prettier --check src adapters tests vite.config.ts eslint.config.js package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.tests.json wrangler.jsonc
